title: Intelligent cloud-based RAS management: integration of DDPG reinforcement learning with AWS IoT for optimized aquaculture production.
summary: A DDPG reinforcement-learning controller adjusts a cloud-connected recirculating aquaculture system; the study reports field testing at a commercial facility and production tanks.
ai_technology: DDPG reinforcement learning controls cloud-connected recirculating aquaculture management; field and production-tank measurements evaluate operation.
